name: Pangasinan Half Marathon 2026
short_description: A half-marathon event in Lingayen, Pangasinan, Philippines, taking place on September 5, 2026, with 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: The Pangasinan Half Marathon 2026 is scheduled for September 5, 2026, in Lingayen, Pangasinan, Philippines, with the Capitol Compound serving as the venue. The event offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runners from beginners to those seeking a half-marathon challenge. It is organized by UR Events. Registration has not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit a range of runner abilities
Set at a notable venue, the Capitol Compound in Lingayen
Organized event with a clear, confirmed date
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so entry details are unavailable
research_highlights: The 2026 edition offers three distance categories: 5K, 10K, and 21K, held at the Capitol Compound in Lingayen, Pangasinan on September 5, 2026.
Registration fees are tiered by distance: ₱899 for 5K, ₱1,299 for 10K, and ₱1,799 for 21K.

The race is organized by UR Events and falls in a busy period on the Philippine race calendar, with other events (Spider-Man Web Head Run, Sante Trilogy Run) scheduled on the same or adjacent days in Metro Manila.

faqs.answer: The race takes place at the Capitol Compound in Lingayen, Pangasinan, Philippines. This venue serves as the central location for the event, which is organized by UR Events and scheduled for September 5, 2026.
